business_applications.declaration:
CREATE TABLE business_applications (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY, application_no text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('TRAVEL','PAYMENT','PREPAYMENT','SUPPLIER_PAYMENT')),
 title text NOT NULL CHECK(char_length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
 amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK(amount>=0), fields jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK(jsonb_typeof(fields)='object'),
 supplier_id uuid REFERENCES suppliers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 applicant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES employees(id), applicant_name text NOT NULL,
 department_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES departments(id), department_name text NOT NULL,
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK(status IN('DRAFT','SUBMITTED','REVIEWING','REJECTED','APPROVED','PAID','COMPLETED','CANCELLED')),
 approval_stage text, round integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 reject_reason text, submitted_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 finance_document_id uuid, finance_document_type text,
 CHECK((status IN('SUBMITTED','REVIEWING','APPROVED'))=(approval_stage IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK(kind<>'TRAVEL' OR status NOT IN('APPROVED','PAID')),
 CHECK((kind IN('SUPPLIER_PAYMENT','PREPAYMENT'))=(supplier_id IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK(kind NOT IN('SUPPLIER_PAYMENT','PREPAYMENT') OR (fields->>'supplierId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM supplier_id::text),
 CHECK(kind NOT IN('PREPAYMENT','SUPPLIER_PAYMENT') OR finance_document_type IS NULL OR finance_document_type='PAYMENT'),
 CHECK((finance_document_id IS NULL)=(finance_document_type IS NULL)),
 CHECK(kind IN('TRAVEL','PREPAYMENT') OR status<>'PAID' OR finance_document_id IS NOT NULL),
 CHECK(status<>'PAID' OR (fields->>'paymentDate' IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(length(btrim(fields->>'paymentReference')),0)>0)),
 UNIQUE(finance_document_type,finance_document_id)
)

business_numeric_input_evidence.declaration:
CREATE TABLE business_numeric_input_evidence(
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY,owner_kind text NOT NULL CHECK(owner_kind~'^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,79}$'),owner_id uuid NOT NULL,
 source_row_id uuid NOT NULL,field_key text NOT NULL CHECK(field_key~'^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.]{0,79}$'),
 owner_version text NOT NULL CHECK(length(owner_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),source_action_id text NOT NULL,
 original_decimal text NOT NULL CHECK(length(original_decimal)<=1100 AND original_decimal~'^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'),
 original_unit jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(original_unit)='object' AND (original_unit->>'kind') IS NOT NULL AND (original_unit->>'kind')~'^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,39}$' AND original_unit-ARRAY['kind','code','referenceId']='{}'::jsonb AND octet_length(original_unit::text)<=2048),
 recorded_decimal text NOT NULL CHECK(length(recorded_decimal)<=100 AND recorded_decimal~'^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND fn_financial_book_amount_is_exact(recorded_decimal::numeric)),
 recorded_unit jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(recorded_unit)='object' AND (recorded_unit->>'kind') IS NOT NULL AND (recorded_unit->>'kind')~'^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,39}$' AND recorded_unit-ARRAY['kind','code','referenceId']='{}'::jsonb AND octet_length(recorded_unit::text)<=2048),
 precision_policy jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(precision_policy)='object' AND (precision_policy->>'version') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM '1' AND jsonb_typeof(precision_policy->'choices') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'object' AND precision_policy-ARRAY['version','choices']='{}'::jsonb AND octet_length(precision_policy::text)<=16384),
 actor_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),request_id uuid,fingerprint text NOT NULL CHECK(fingerprint~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 UNIQUE(owner_kind,owner_id,source_row_id,field_key,source_action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE finance_auxiliary_items (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), source_system text NOT NULL,
    source_code text NOT NULL, source_name text NOT NULL,
    role text NOT NULL CHECK(role IN('CUSTOMER','SUPPLIER','EMPLOYEE','OTHER')),
    party_id uuid, client_id uuid REFERENCES clients(id), supplier_id uuid REFERENCES suppliers(id),
    employee_id uuid REFERENCES employees(id), financial_party_id uuid REFERENCES finance_auxiliary_parties(id),
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK(status IN('ACTIVE','ARCHIVED')),
    source_reference text, row_version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), updated_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    UNIQUE(source_system,role,source_code),CHECK(length(btrim(source_system)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
    CHECK(length(btrim(source_code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),CHECK(length(btrim(source_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
    CONSTRAINT finance_auxiliary_items_party_shape CHECK (
        (party_id IS NULL AND num_nonnulls(client_id,supplier_id,employee_id,financial_party_id)=0)
        OR (party_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(client_id,supplier_id,employee_id,financial_party_id)=1 AND (
            (role='CUSTOMER' AND client_id IS NOT NULL AND client_id=party_id)
            OR (role='SUPPLIER' AND supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND supplier_id=party_id)
            OR (role='EMPLOYEE' AND employee_id IS NOT NULL AND employee_id=party_id)
            OR (role='OTHER' AND financial_party_id IS NOT NULL AND financial_party_id=party_id))))
)

CREATE TABLE finance_auxiliary_parties (

    net_amount numeric NOT NULL CHECK(net_amount>=0 AND fn_financial_amount_is_exact(net_amount)),
    fee_amount numeric NOT NULL CHECK(fee_amount>=0 AND fn_financial_amount_is_exact(fee_amount)),
    bank_amount numeric NOT NULL CHECK(bank_amount>=0 AND fn_financial_amount_is_exact(bank_amount)),
    fee_style_id uuid REFERENCES payment_styles(id),
    payment_voucher_id uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES gl_vouchers(id),
    non_cash_voucher_id uuid REFERENCES gl_vouchers(id),
    receipt_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BANK_PAYMENT' CHECK(receipt_kind IN('BANK_PAYMENT','NON_CASH_CLEARED','NO_FINANCIAL_EVENT')),
    source_claim_only boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    account_flow_id uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES finance_reconciliations(id),
    state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('POSTED_PENDING_CONFIRMATION','NON_CASH_CLEARED','NO_FINANCIAL_EVENT','CONFIRMED','REVERSED')),

    CHECK(net_amount+fee_amount=bank_amount),CHECK((fee_amount=0)=(fee_style_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK((state='REVERSED' AND (reversal_voucher_id IS NOT NULL OR receipt_kind='NO_FINANCIAL_EVENT' OR source_claim_only)) OR (state<>'REVERSED' AND reversal_voucher_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK((receipt_kind='BANK_PAYMENT' AND net_amount>0 AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND payment_voucher_id IS NOT NULL AND account_flow_id IS NOT NULL AND non_cash_voucher_id IS NULL AND NOT source_claim_only)

 goods_code_snapshot text, goods_name_snapshot text, unit_name_snapshot text,
 required_qty numeric NOT NULL CHECK(required_qty>0),
 original_required_qty numeric NOT NULL CHECK(original_required_qty>0),
 adoption_scale integer CHECK(adoption_scale BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
 adoption_rounding text CHECK(adoption_rounding IN('HALF_UP','DOWN')),
 required_operations jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb CHECK(jsonb_typeof(required_operations)='array'),
 processing_targets jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb CHECK(jsonb_typeof(processing_targets)='array'),
 warehouse_id uuid REFERENCES warehouses(id), stock_place text,
 processing_completed_qty numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(processing_completed_qty>=0 AND processing_completed_qty<=required_qty),
 processing_evidence text, processing_completed_by uuid, processing_completed_at timestamptz,
 movement_id uuid REFERENCES stock_movements(id),
 reversal_movement_id uuid REFERENCES stock_movements(id),
 revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 UNIQUE(shipment_item_id,bom_path)
 ,CHECK(required_qty<100000000000000 AND required_qty=trunc(required_qty,4))
 ,CHECK((adoption_scale IS NULL AND adoption_rounding IS NULL AND required_qty=original_required_qty)
  OR (adoption_scale IS NOT NULL AND adoption_rounding IS NOT NULL AND required_qty=
   CASE WHEN adoption_rounding='HALF_UP' THEN round(original_required_qty,adoption_scale)
    ELSE trunc(original_required_qty,adoption_scale) END))
)
